title: cacalia crotonoides
intro: Cacalia crotonoides, commonly known as the Mexican gold poppy, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cacalia crotonoides include its ability to reduce inflammation, modulate the immune system, and exhibit analgesic and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, although further research is needed to fully understand its chemical composition and potential applications.
